name: wybe-connect
description: Feeds your Wybe AI colleague from Codex with the essence of your work: a background distil on your machine (codex exec) turns your sessions into short, redacted work facts and delivers each exactly once; on first connect it imports every Codex session still on your machine by itself. Nothing raw leaves the machine. The plugin's own MCP server and the connect skill pair this machine once. Sends only; the one thing that comes back is a task you gave your colleague for an open session, and one that needs your yes is shown to you first.
